name: video_color_grade
description: Grades a clip, either with a catalog LUT (`lutId` from `video_luts_list`, optionally softened with `intensity`) or with manual `adjustments`. Pass at least one of the two; both together apply the LUT and then the adjustments. Matching another clip's look instead → `video_color_transfer`. Max 20s / 200 MB. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

adjustments.description: Manual grade. Required without `lutId`. Omitted axes stay at 0.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation. Max 20s, 200 MB.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

intensity.description: How strongly the LUT is applied, 0-100. Default 100.

lutId.description: LUT to apply, from `video_luts_list`. Required without `adjustments`.
